lines.text: King Solomon ruled over Israel, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada was in charge of the army.
Solomon had twelve governors over all Israel, and each one provided food for the king for one month.
Solomon reigned over all the kingdoms from the Jordan to the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt.
God gave Solomon wisdom greater than all the men of the East, and he was wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite.
Solomon spoke of trees, from the cedar in Bashan to the hyssop, and men of all nations listened.
